entities.summary: Jesper B. Jensen Aabo is a Danish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for EC KAC of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). He was a member of the Denmark men's national ice hockey team for the 2011 World Championship. At just 19 years of age, he was the youngest member of the Danish team.
